description: This Java source file defines the 'BaseUnretireHandler' class, which implements logic to unretire (reactivate) objects implementing the 'Retireable' interface within the OpenMRS system. It contains a method 'handle' that resets retirement attributes such as 'retired' status, 'retiredBy', 'dateRetired', and 'retireReason' to null, under specific conditions.

classes.name: BaseUnretireHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for unretiring Retireable objects by resetting their retirement properties.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles unretiring an object by setting its retirement attributes (retired, retiredBy, dateRetired, retireReason) to null, provided that the object is currently retired and matches the original retirement date.
